enableCamera.title: Enable Camera
enableCamera.description: Expose the door camera's live view and snapshots in HomeKit.

videoProcessor.title: Video Processor Path
videoProcessor.description: Path to an ffmpeg binary. Leave blank to use the bundled ffmpeg-for-homebridge binary, falling back to 'ffmpeg' on your system PATH.

enableVacationSwitch.title: Enable Vacation Mode Switch
enableVacationSwitch.description: Vacation Mode locks out the door's wireless remote transmitters (handheld clickers), so it won't respond to them until you turn it back off — useful when you're away and want to rule out a lost or cloned remote as a way in. The door can still be opened from HomeKit/Siri or the CGD app while it's on. Disable this to hide the switch tile in the Home app.

vacationSwitchName.title: Vacation Mode Switch Name
vacationSwitchName.description: Customize this if you have another accessory named "Vacation Mode" in the same home.

enableStopSwitch.title: Enable Stop Switch
enableStopSwitch.description: A momentary button that stops the door mid-travel. Disable this to hide the switch tile in the Home app.

stopSwitchName.title: Stop Switch Name
stopSwitchName.description: Customize this if you have another accessory named "Stop" in the same home.

transitionTimeoutSeconds.title: Transition Timeout (seconds)
transitionTimeoutSeconds.description: How long (in seconds) the door can stay in a transitional state (Opening or Closing) before the plugin considers it stuck and resets the displayed state to Stopped. Set it comfortably above your door's travel time (for example, a door that takes about 19 s to open and 13 s to close is fine at the default of 60). Set to 0 to disable the watchdog.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Idle Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to check the door's status while it is idle. Lower values notice remote or wall-button use sooner but put more load on a device that only handles one connection at a time.

pollIntervalMovingSeconds.title: Moving Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalMovingSeconds.description: How often to check the door's status while it is opening or closing, so HomeKit tracks the movement.

unreachableAfterFailures.title: Failed Polls Before No Response
unreachableAfterFailures.description: How many status checks in a row must fail before HomeKit shows the door as "No Response". Failed checks also back off exponentially (up to 60 seconds) so an unresponsive door isn't hammered.

healthSummaryMinutes.title: Health Summary Interval (minutes)
healthSummaryMinutes.description: How often to log a one-line health summary (poll success rate, latency, Wi-Fi signal, cycle count, last error). Set to 0 to disable.
